definitionEn: n. a characteristic likelihood of or natural disposition toward a certain condition or character or effect\nn. a general direction in which something tends to move
definitionZh: n. 趋向, 倾向\n[医] 趋向, 趋势

example.text: She has a tendency to interrupt people when she gets excited.
example.translationZh: 她一激动就有打断别人说话的倾向。

example.text: The shopkeeper refused to accept the old banknotes, even though they are still legal tender.
example.translationZh: 店主拒绝接受这些旧纸币，尽管它们仍是法定货币。

definitionEn: n. a game played with rackets by two or four players who hit a ball back and forth over a net that divides the court
definitionZh: n. 网球

example.text: We play tennis at the park every Saturday morning.
example.translationZh: 我们每周六早上在公园打网球。

definitionEn:
n. (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense
n. the physical condition of being stretched or strained
n. a balance between and interplay of opposing elements or tendencies (especially in art or literature)

example.text: She took a deep breath to ease the tension before the meeting.
example.translationZh: 她在会议前深吸一口气以缓解紧张。

definitionEn: n. something that acts like a tentacle in its ability to grasp and hold\nn. any of various elongated tactile or prehensile flexible organs that occur on the head or near the mouth in many animals; used for feeling or grasping or locomotion
definitionZh: n. 触须, 触手, 触角\n[医] 触角, 触须

example.text: The octopus reached out a tentacle to explore the rock.
example.translationZh: 章鱼伸出一只触手来探索那块岩石。

definitionEn: s under terms not final or fully worked out or agreed upon\ns unsettled in mind or opinion
definitionZh: n. 试验\na. 试验性的, 暂时的

example.text: The two countries reached a tentative agreement on the trade issues.
example.translationZh: 两国就贸易问题达成了一项临时协议。

definitionEn:
n. a word or expression used for some particular thing
n. a limited period of time
n. any distinct quantity contained in a polynomial
n. one of the substantive phrases in a logical proposition

example.text: Investing in education benefits society in the long term.
example.translationZh: 从长远来看，投资教育对社会有益。

definitionEn:
n. station where transport vehicles load or unload passengers or goods
n. a contact on an electrical device (such as a battery) at which electric current enters or leaves

example.text: We waited for the bus at the terminal.
example.translationZh: 我们在终点站等公交车。

example.translationZh: 两家公司最终就合同条款达成了一致。

definitionEn:
n. a level shelf of land interrupting a declivity (with steep slopes above and below)
n. a row of houses built in a similar style and having common dividing walls (or the street on which they face)
v. provide (a house) with a terrace
v. make into terraces as for cultivation
definitionZh: n. 阶地, 梯田, 房屋之平顶, 阳台, 沿岸防地, 露台\na. 叠层式的\nvt. 使成梯田, 使成有平台屋顶

example.text: They grew tomatoes and herbs on the roof terrace.
example.translationZh: 他们在屋顶露台上种了西红柿和香草。

definitionEn: n. a piece of ground having specific characteristics or military potential
definitionZh: n. 地带, 地区, 地形, 领域, 范围

example.text: The jeep was built to handle rough terrain.
example.translationZh: 这辆吉普车是为应对崎岖地形而制造的。

definitionEn: a. operating or living or growing on land
definitionZh: n. 地球上的人\na. 地球的, 陆生的, 陆地的, 人间的

example.text: Unlike fish, terrestrial animals must find water on land to survive.
example.translationZh: 与鱼类不同，陆生动物必须在陆地上找到水才能生存。

definitionEn: s. very great or intense\ns. causing extreme terror
definitionZh: a. 非常好的, 极端的, 可怕的

example.text: She came up with a terrific idea for the school fundraiser.
example.translationZh: 她为学校募捐活动想出了一个极好的主意。

definitionEn: v. fill with terror; frighten greatly
definitionZh: vt. 使恐惧, 恐吓

example.text: The thunderstorm terrified the small children.
example.translationZh: 雷雨吓坏了小孩子们。

definitionEn:
n. nonprofessional soldier member of a territorial military unit
n. a territorial military unit
a. of or relating to a territory
a. displaying territoriality; defending a territory from intruders
definitionZh: a. 领土的, 土地的, 地方的, 区域性的\nn. 本土自卫队队员

example.text: The country accused the foreign fishing boat of entering its territorial waters without permission.
example.translationZh: 该国指责那艘外国渔船未经许可进入其领海。

definitionEn: n. an area of knowledge or interest\nn. the geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign state
definitionZh: n. 领土, 领地, 版图, 地区, 活动范围\n[经] (推销员等的)推销区域

example.text: Selling online took the small company into uncharted territory.
example.translationZh: 线上销售把小公司带入了未知领域。

definitionEn: n. a person who inspires fear or dread\nn. a very troublesome child\nn. the use of extreme fear in order to coerce people (especially for political reasons)
definitionZh: n. 恐怖, 可怕的人\n[医] 惊吓, 惊悸

example.text: The villagers fled in terror when the wildfire swept down the hillside.
example.translationZh: 当野火从山坡上席卷而下时，村民们惊恐地逃走了。

definitionEn: s brief and to the point; effectively cut short; `yes'"
definitionZh: a. 简洁的, 扼要的

example.text: His terse reply made it clear that he had no interest in discussing the matter further.
example.translationZh: 他简短生硬的答复清楚地表明，他无意再讨论这件事。

definitionEn: n. from 63 million to 2 million years ago

example.text: She pursued tertiary education at a university in the capital.
example.translationZh: 她在首都的一所大学接受了高等教育。

definitionEn:
n. any standardized procedure for measuring sensitivity or memory or intelligence or aptitude or personality etc
n. the act of undergoing testing
n. the act of testing something
n. a hard outer covering as of some amoebas and sea urchins

example.translationZh: 她明天上午必须参加一场数学考试。

definitionEn: n. a solemn statement made under oath\nn. an assertion offering firsthand authentication of a fact\nn. something that serves as evidence
definitionZh: n. 证言, 证据, 声明\n[医] 证据

example.translationZh: 证人被传唤在庭审中作证。

definitionEn: n. a book prepared for use in schools or colleges
definitionZh: n. 教科书

example.text: The teacher opened her textbook to page fifty and began the lesson.
example.translationZh: 老师把教科书翻到第五十页，开始上课。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to fabrics or fabric making
definitionZh: n. 纺织品, 纺织业\na. 织的, 纺织的

example.translationZh: 这座城市的经济长期以来一直依赖纺织业。

definitionEn:

n. the musical pattern created by parts being played or sung together
n. the characteristic appearance of a surface having a tactile quality

example.translationZh: 这种丝绸面料质地光滑，贴在皮肤上感觉凉爽。

definitionZh: n. 融解, 融化, 解冻时期\nvt. 使融解, 使缓和\nvi. 融化, 解冻

example.text: After years of tension, there was a gradual thaw in relations between the two countries.
example.translationZh: 经过多年的紧张局势，两国关系逐渐缓和。

definitionEn: n a building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented\nn the art of writing and producing plays\nn a region in which active military operations are in progress
definitionZh: n. 戏院, 电影院, 剧场, 全体观众, 戏剧, 戏剧效果, 阶梯式讲堂, 场所

example.text: We went to the theatre last night to see a new play.
example.translationZh: 我们昨晚去剧院看了一出新戏。

definitionEn: n the act of taking something from someone unlawfully

example.translationZh: 他因偷窃邻居的自行车而被逮捕。

definitionEn: a. concerned primarily with theories or hypotheses rather than practical considerations\na. concerned with theories rather than their practical applications
definitionZh: a. 理论的, 理论上的, 假设的, 推理的\n[计] 理论的

example.translationZh: 这项研究建立在坚实的理论框架之上。

definitionZh: n. 治疗学家\n[医] 治疗学家

example.translationZh: 膝盖手术后，她每周看两次物理治疗师以恢复力量。

example.translationZh: 膝盖手术后，她每周去两次做物理治疗。

definitionEn:

a. of or relating to a hot spring
s. caused by or designed to retain heat

example.translationZh: 这座新建筑利用太阳能电池板产生热能来加热水。
